DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (likely 11β-hydroxylase deficiency).

The combination of virilization (clitoromegaly, hirsutism), delayed menarche, and bone fragility is highly suggestive of an androgen-secreting disorder. I recommend confirming this with a 17-hydroxyprogesterone and androgen profile.
